# Splendor - Smart Car Wash Booking System

> Splendor is a modern smart car wash reservation platform offering online booking with real-time bay availability, service packages, and calendar scheduling.

## Main Services
- Exterior & Interior Car Wash
- Express Detailing & Polishing
- Ceramic Coating & Paint Protection
- Real-time booking with branch selection and time slots

## Website URL
- https://splendor-beryl.vercel.app/
